purpose: Evaluate the Source and RelCompat3D rankings with raw point- and mesh-surface measurements that do not reuse the OBB measurements consumed by the compatibility model or the main verifier.

excluded_from_primary_audit.support_contact: kept in source order by the primary ranking rule and excluded because point contact requires a separate relation-specific construct

firewall.threshold_reference: GT-positive proximity and relative-vertical relations whose scan_id is in the frozen 1,061-scan training split
firewall.validation_use: evaluation only; no threshold, support, family, K, or status-rule changes

point_audit.sampling: deterministic SHA-256-seeded uniform sampling without replacement
point_audit.proximity_measurement: symmetric 10th percentile of cross-object nearest-vertex distances divided by the mean robust point radius
point_audit.vertical_measurement: predicate-signed difference between subject and object median vertex elevation divided by the mean robust point radius
point_audit.object_scale: 90th percentile Euclidean radius about the coordinate-wise vertex median

mesh_audit.representation: triangle centroids and triangle areas from faces whose three instance-labeled vertices belong to the same object
mesh_audit.sampling: deterministic SHA-256-seeded uniform triangle sampling without replacement
mesh_audit.proximity_measurement: area-weighted symmetric 10th percentile of cross-object nearest-triangle-centroid distances divided by an area-equivalent pair scale
mesh_audit.vertical_measurement: predicate-signed difference between subject and object area-weighted median triangle-centroid elevation divided by the area-equivalent pair scale
mesh_audit.object_scale: square root of object triangle area divided by pi

raw_surface_contract.non_overlap_with_model: The audit never reads semseg OBB centroids, axes, distances, projected overlap, or vertical-gap features. Point and mesh estimators share the reconstructed surface but use distinct vertex-unweighted and face-area-weighted statistics.

minimum_surface_support.point: max(32, floor(P01)) endpoint vertices over training-positive endpoints
minimum_surface_support.mesh: max(16, floor(P01)) endpoint triangles over training-positive endpoints

proximity.uncertain: training-positive P90 < normalized surface distance <= training-positive P99

relative_vertical.margin: training-positive P10 of the absolute predicate-signed normalized surface-elevation difference

train_only_status_rules.unsupported: either endpoint falls below the frozen representation-specific surface-support threshold or the required surface statistic is unavailable
train_only_status_rules.consensus: satisfied or violated only when point and mesh return the same decided status; otherwise uncertain when both audits are supported, and unsupported when either audit is unsupported

ranking.relcompat3d: preserve the source sequence of relation-family labels; order support/contact by the source score and proximity/relative-vertical by source score times transformation-consistent compatibility
ranking.missing_contexts: retain in Recall denominators with no selected prediction

metrics.recall: exact-label Recall@K, reported both over all 3,972 GT relations and over proximity/relative-vertical GT relations
metrics.audit_violation: violated / (satisfied + uncertain + violated) among selected proximity/relative-vertical predictions

uncertainty.shared_scan_indices: the same 157-scan resampling indices are used for every source, method, K, metric, and audit

synthetic_intervention.selection: deterministic SHA-256 order from the union of Source and RelCompat3D K=100 proximity/relative-vertical selections
synthetic_intervention.proximity_surface_intervention: translate the subject horizontally away from the object along the ordered-pair median direction
synthetic_intervention.vertical_surface_intervention: translate the subject in the predicate-consistent vertical direction
synthetic_intervention.compatibility_intervention: apply the corresponding monotone distance/overlap or predicate-aligned elevation change to a copy of the candidate geometry features and recompute the frozen compatibility score
synthetic_intervention.role: mechanism test only; it is not included in the observational audit metric

claim_boundary: Agreement under point, mesh, and strict consensus reduces exact OBB-rule circularity. It remains an automatic construct-validity audit of reconstructed 3RScan surfaces, not human physical-validity ground truth or evidence of cross-dataset generalization.
